nodes.description: OLEMS OER lattice oxygen participation test in 0.1 M KOH (pH ~13)

labelling_procedure.value: ¹⁸O-labelled by potentiostatic hold at 1.6 V vs Au in H₂¹⁸O-0.1 M KOH for 10 min, then rinsed with H₂¹⁶O

nodes.source_text: Neither normalized m/z = 34 (Fig. 2a) nor m/z = 36 (Fig. 2b) was detected during the OER for LaCoO₃, indicating there was no oxygen from the LaCoO₃ lattice in the molecular oxygen evolved. The minimum oxide thickness involved during OER was estimated to be ∼0.5 nm for LaCoO₃, indicating a surface OER process.

nodes.description: Galvanostatic oxygen intercalation test in O₂ and Ar saturated 1 M KOH

oxygen_intercalation_plateau.value: present in O₂-saturated, absent in Ar-saturated

nodes.source_text: Galvanostatic oxidation of brownmillerite SrCoO₃₋δ in O₂-saturated 1 M KOH led to the well-known plateau of oxygen intercalation, whereas oxidation with Ar saturation exhibited no clear plateau of oxygen intercalation.

nodes.description: Galvanostatic oxygen intercalation in O₂- and Ar-saturated 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: Galvanostatic charging (iR-corrected) of SrCoO₃₋δ in O₂-saturated (solid line) and Ar-saturated (dotted line) 1 M KOH as a function of charge passed at 7 mA g_oxide⁻¹. The oxide loading was 0.25 mg_oxide cm_disk⁻² mixed with a carbon loading of 0.05 mg_carbon cm_disk⁻². In O₂-saturated 1 M KOH led to the well-known plateau of oxygen intercalation, whereas oxidation with Ar saturation exhibited no clear plateau of oxygen intercalation.

nodes.characterization_summary: All perovskite catalysts confirmed single-phase by XRD with lattice parameters consistent with literature (Supplementary Table 1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: All catalysts reported in this study are single-phase, as analysed by X-ray diffraction (XRD), with lattice parameters consistent with those reported previously (Supplementary Table 1).

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface areas determined for all oxide catalysts (values in Supplementary Table 2).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The specific surface area of each oxide sample was determined using Brunauer, Emmet and Teller (BET) analysis on a Quantachrome ChemBET Pulsar from single-point BET analysis performed after 12 h outgassing at 150 °C (Supplementary Table 2).
